Generated Narrative: ValueSet fiji-evidence-vs

This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where expression = (< 404684003 |Clinical finding| MINUS < 64572001 |Disease|) AND ^ 10811000132104 |International Patient Summary reference set|
  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where expression = < 71388002 |Procedure| AND ^ 10811000132104 |International Patient Summary reference set|
  • Include codes fromhttp://loinc.org version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a LP29684-5 (RAD)
  • Include codes fromhttp://loinc.org version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a LP29700-9
